            fx = max(min(fx, 50.0), -50.0)
            fy = max(min(fy, 50.0), -50.0)
            mag = math.hypot(fx, fy)
            if mag > 60.0:
                fx = fx * 60.0 / mag
                fy = fy * 60.0 / mag

            sandbox.apply_agent_force(fx, fy)
            return

    else:
        # Default movement towards next switch
        tx, ty = _ZONE_CENTERS[next_switch]
        dx = tx - x
        dy = ty - y
        dist = math.hypot(dx, dy)
        if dist < 1e-6:
            sandbox.apply_agent_force(-2.0 * vx, -2.0 * vy)
            return

        force_mag = min(mf, 10.0 * dist)
        ux, uy = (dx / dist, dy / dist) if dist > 1e-6 else (0, 0)
        fx = force_mag * ux
        fy = force_mag * uy

        # Scale to ensure speed <= 0.05 m/s
        if speed > 0.05:
            scale = 0.05 / speed
            fx *= scale
            fy *= scale

        # Clamp force
        fx = max(min(fx, 50.0), -50.0)
        fy = max(min(fy, 50.0), -50.0)
        mag = math.hypot(fx, fy)
        if mag > 60.0:
            fx = fx * 60.0 / mag
            fy = fy * 60.0 / mag

        sandbox.apply_agent_force(fx, fy)
        return
